$comment: Lock file for the v64 engine binaries. The seven rebuilt files (v86.wasm, v86-fallback.wasm, v86-parallel.wasm, libv86.mjs, cpu-worker.js, vcpu-worker.js and the USB plugin v86-usb.js) are NOT the upstream bytes served by `url`: they are the upstream 74d2bafc build with `scripts/patches/v64-ioapic-irq0-gsi2.patch`, then `scripts/patches/v64-ata-power-management.patch`, then `scripts/patches/v64-usb-keyboard.patch`, then `scripts/patches/v64-smc-device.patch` applied by `scripts/build-v64-assets.sh`, rebuilt in a clean tree (glbridge/vx_naga.wasm is re-emitted by the same build). Their `url` stays the upstream provenance for the same path, so `prepare-v64-assets.mjs` fails loudly instead of silently installing an unpatched binary. Every other asset is byte-identical to upstream.
patch: IRQ0 -> GSI2 in the I/O APIC and in the MADT interrupt source override (Windows 11 24H2 HAL clock), HPET main-counter period 100 ns, extended CPUID leaves (0x80000001 / 0x80000007 / 0x80000008); ATA STANDBY (0xE2), IDLE (0xE3) and SLEEP (0xE6) complete with DRDY like STANDBY/IDLE IMMEDIATE instead of aborting, so the AHCI port no longer latches `halted` on the macOS driver's power-management commands; a USB HID boot keyboard on the USB plugin (src/usb/hid_keyboard.js, `usb.keyboard`), typed into with the bus's `keyboard-usage` [usage, down] (HID usages 0x04-0x65, modifiers 0xE0-0xE7) and announcing `usb-keyboard-active`, because macOS Lion has no PS/2 driver; an Apple SMC (`smc: true`, src/smc.js) as QEMU's isa-applesmc: READ (0x10) on ports 0x300/0x304/0x31E, the REV/OSK0/OSK1/NATJ/MSSP/MSSD keys and its error codes, a Device(SMC) _HID "APP0001" with I/O 0x300-0x31F and IRQ 6 in the q35 ACPI tables (whose FDC0 then gives up IRQ 6), and the snapshot slots for its registers; it is refused with the NE2000 (net_device type "ne2k", the default), which owns 0x300 too

build.command: make build/v86.wasm build/v86-fallback.wasm build/v86-parallel.wasm build/libv86.mjs build/cpu-worker.js build/vcpu-worker.js build/v86-usb.js
